stage.narration_span: و بعد، طرف مقابل یا بلافاصله پیام میداد، یا صبح روز بعد، یا دو روز بعد.

frame_review.observed: start/middle/end of the selected window: the same three phones on the same plain wall, nothing moving into the empty centre band.

review.relevance_reason: three identical phones standing against a plain wall are literally the beat's three message timings (immediate, next morning, two days), with the subject in frame.
review.selection_reason: three phones on an empty wall: the centre band stays plain so the moment copy sits clear of them, and the shot states 'three options' without narrating it.

stage.narration_span: از اون طرف، دو روز صبر کردن هم کمکی نکرد؛

frame_review.observed: start/middle/end of the selected window: the same table and vase with both chairs empty, nothing entering or leaving the frame.

review.relevance_reason: the beat is «از اون طرف، دو روز صبر کردن هم کمکی نکرد»; an untouched breakfast table with two empty chairs and nobody at it is that beat's stillness. The phone is honestly absent, and this is a non-literal read.
review.selection_reason: a real apartment kitchen table: tulips, glass, empty chairs, nobody in frame. It reads as a place waiting for someone and gives the film its one beat of pure object stillness before the result is named.

geometry_review.observed: 1080x1920 source used at full frame; no crop needed.

reject.reason: same shoot and same person as ve-9's candidate (a breakfast scene in the same white room); two adjacent shots of one man in one room read as a single long take, and the clip is a person eating rather than the phone left waiting that ve-8 needs.

stage.narration_span: افراد احساس شیمی و انگیزه کمتری برای ادامه ارتباط داشتند و طرف مقابل رو کمتر قابلاعتماد میدیدند.

frame_review.observed: start/middle/end of the selected window: the same man at the table with the phone, spoon and cup; the wall behind him stays plain across the window.

review.relevance_reason: the beat is 'two days of waiting helped nothing'; a man alone at a table with his phone, eating without looking up, is that beat without staging a breakdown.
review.selection_reason: man alone at a white table with a phone and a cup, plain pale wall behind and the upper band clear. The affect is deliberately muted — absorbed and alone rather than visibly upset — which is what 'nothing came of it' looks like; recorded as a read, not an accident.

geometry_review.observed: 1080x2048 source; a 9:16 cover crop trims ~6% of the height and keeps the man and the wall above him.

stage.narration_span: یعنی حداقل در این آزمایش، «دیر پیام بده تا مشتاق به نظر نرسی» استراتژی خیلی خوبی نبود.

frame_review.observed: start/middle/end of the selected window: looking at the phone, then the phone on the table, then leaning back with clasped hands; same man, same table throughout.

review.relevance_reason: the beat says «دیر پیام بده» was not a good strategy; a man who reads his phone, puts it down and sits back with his hands clasped enacts exactly that verdict.
review.selection_reason: one continuous action across the window — phone read, phone set on the table, then sitting back — so the shot argues the beat instead of illustrating it. The dark cafe background leaves the upper band clean for type.

geometry_review.observed: 1080x1920 source used at full frame; no crop needed.

reject.reason: the cafe-table clip is a child in a pink jumper scrolling a phone; narratively wrong for a dating subject and misleading beside «دیر پیام بده تا مشتاق به نظر نرسی».

stage.narration_span: حالا تو بگو: بعد از قرار اول، همون شب پیام میدی، فردا صبح یا صبر میکنی؟

review.relevance_reason: the closing question asks what the viewer would do; two hands composing a message over a keyboard is the answer being typed.
review.selection_reason: hands holding a phone on a live message thread with an unsent line under the keyboard; the phone and the act of writing are unmistakable. The interface text is small and out of focus at delivery size.

geometry_review.observed: 1080x2048 source; a 9:16 cover crop trims ~6% of the height and keeps the phone whole in the centre.
